Create the file case_120.inp in the working directory using the exact content from the Input deck section.
Do not modify the input deck or change the physics of the model.
Run CalculiX using the command `ccx -i case_120`; if that command is not accepted on the system, run `ccx case_120` instead.
Check the file case_120.sta for a line indicating successful termination, such as 'JOB COMPLETED'.
Determine the run status as "success" if the job completed successfully, otherwise "error".
Obtain the CalculiX version string by running `ccx -v`.
Write the file results.json in the working directory with the schema containing the fields solver, case_id, status, ccx_version, artifacts, and notes.
Set the solver field to "calculix".
Set the case_id field to "case_120".
Set the status field to the determined run status.
Set the ccx_version field to the version string obtained from `ccx -v`.
Set the artifacts field to an empty list.
In the notes field, record the exact ccx command used and the file that indicated the run status; if the run failed, include the error message and the file that indicated the failure.
